2923.title: Path plugin version after reload
2923.rootCauseOneLine: The plugin list ignores the loaded manifest version and always returns the stored install version.
2923.proposedFix: Return the loaded manifest version when a plugin instance exists, and use the stored version otherwise.
2923.caveats: The reproduction uses the server test harness instead of a live CLI process. It directly exercises path installation, manifest replacement, reload, and list output.
